lines.text: Many learners say: I work like a teacher.
Better: I work as a teacher.
As! He works as a doctor.

native.tip: Para profesión o función usa “as”. “Like” significa “parecido a”.
native.caption: En español “como” sirve para todo 👩‍🏫 En inglés no digas “I work like a teacher.”, sino “I work as a teacher.”. ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “as”. “As” = profesión; “like” = parecido. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.tip: For a job or role use “as”. “Like” means “similar to”.
en.caption: In Spanish “como” works for both. In English do not say “I work like a teacher.”, say “I work as a teacher.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
